sentences.text: The KFS evidence identifies the document as a Key Facts Statement and says a UCB shall provide a KFS before executing the loan contract, but the evidence provided does not show any pre-payment charge in that KFS.
The home loan agreement evidence is inconsistent on the pre-payment charge, with one version stating 2% of principal outstanding and another version stating 3% of principal outstanding.
On the materials provided, the KFS and the home loan agreement cannot be confirmed to state the same pre-payment charge.

missing.searched: Checked the provided KFS evidence for any stated pre-payment charge; the excerpt supplied only identifies the KFS and does not include the charge term.
